camel_example: aliyun aidge AssetOptimizePro --region cn-hangzhou --SourcePlatform 1688 --TargetPlatform temu --NeedTrans true --ProductUrl 'https://detail.1688.com/offer/771024907536.html' --version 2026-04-28 --method POST --force
description_en: Provides a one-click cross-platform product material optimization service for cross-border e-commerce sellers (optimal performance edition). This asynchronous operation takes 1688 product links as input and generates a full set of materials tailored to TEMU platform requirements, including titles, attributes, main images, SKU images, detail images, and copy. It uses officially pre-configured optimal workflows to maximize AI capabilities, retains and localizes brand marketing materials, and generates personalized materials such as size charts for categories like apparel
description_zh: 面向跨境电商卖家的跨平台商品素材一键优化服务（最佳效果版）。输入1688商品链接，一键输出适配TEMU平台要求的标题、属性、主图、SKU图、详情图与文案等全量素材。采用官方预制的最好效果流程，最大化调用AI能力，保留并本地化品牌营销素材，并针对服饰等类目输出尺码表等个性化素材。（异步）
kebab_example: aliyun aidge asset-optimize-pro --product-url https://detail.1688.com/offer/771024907536.html --source-platform 1688 --target-platform temu --need-trans true --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssetOptimizePro

parameters.help_en: The product URL. This parameter is required. Currently, only 1688 product links are supported
parameters.help_zh: 商品URL，必填。目前仅支持1688商品链接
parameters.name: product_url

parameters.help_en: The source platform. Currently, only 1688 is supported
parameters.name: source_platform

parameters.help_en: The target platform for product listing. Currently, only TEMU is supported
parameters.name: target_platform

parameters.help_en: The source language code. This parameter is optional. For supported language pairs, see the list of supported translation languages. This parameter is required if NeedTrans is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 源语言代码，选填。支持的语向见翻译支持语向列表。如果NeedTrans为true则必填
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The target language code. This parameter is optional. For supported language pairs, see the list of supported translation languages. This parameter is required if NeedTrans is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 目标语言代码，选填。支持的语向见翻译支持语向列表。如果NeedTrans为true则必填
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether translation is required. Valid values: true and false. If this parameter is set to true, SourceLanguage and TargetLanguage are required
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要翻译（true/false）。设为true时，SourceLanguage和TargetLanguage为必填
parameters.name: need_trans

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate the text on the main subject of the image. This helps protect embedded information such as product names from being translated. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 选择是否翻译图片主体上文字，可帮助保护商品名称等嵌入信息避免被翻译。默认false
parameters.name: including_product_area

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate brand names in images. This parameter is optional. Default value: false. This helps protect brand names from being translated
parameters.help_zh: 是否翻译图片上的品牌名，选填，默认false。可帮助保护品牌名信息避免被翻译
parameters.name: translating_brand_in_the_product

parameters.help_en: The ID of the intervention glossary. This parameter is optional. You must create the glossary in the console and provide its ID. If this parameter is left empty, the translation results are not modified
parameters.help_zh: 干预词表ID，选填。需在前台单独创建并提供其ID。如果为空则翻译结果不会被修改
parameters.name: glossary

parameters.help_en: The confidence threshold for size chart detection. Default value: 0.4. If this parameter is set to 0, all images are considered size charts. If this parameter is set to 1, no images are considered size charts
parameters.help_zh: 尺码图检测置信度，默认为0.4。设为0时全部都认为是尺码表，设为1时全不是尺码表
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: The list of column names to be recognized in the size chart. This parameter is optional
parameters.help_zh: 尺码图需要识别的列名列表，选填
parameters.name: column_name_list

parameters.help_en: The output language format for the size chart. If this parameter is left empty, the original language is used. Valid values: en for English, cn for Chinese
parameters.help_zh: 尺码图输出语言格式，不填默认原版输出。en输出英文，cn输出中文
parameters.name: language_model

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of success is returned for successful calls
Code.description_zh: 状态码，正常调用时返回"success"

Data.description_en: The submission result of the asynchronous task, which includes the asynchronous task ID
Data.description_zh: 异步任务提交结果数据，包含异步任务ID

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task, which is used to query the processing result by calling QueryAsyncTaskResult
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务ID，用于后续通过QueryAsyncTaskResult查询处理结果
TaskId.title_en: 异步任务ID，用于后续查询结果
TaskId.title_zh: 异步任务ID，用于后续查询结果

Message.description_en: The error message. A value of Success is returned for successful calls
Message.description_zh: 报错信息。正常调用时返回"Success"

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to identify a unique request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用来识别唯一一次请求调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 是否调用成功。true代表成功，false代表失败
